title: Circle Line tunnel reinforcement progress and commuter rebates
asked: Gerald Giam asked for the percentage of steel rings installed in the Circle Line tunnel reinforcement works, whether technical issues had been encountered, and whether the April 2026 completion date could be brought forward to reduce daily travel delays.
response: Jeffrey Siow said about 50% of the required steel rings had been installed as at end-February 2026, and works remained on schedule for completion by 19 April 2026. He said it was not possible to bring the project timelines forward because the works are complex and safety of workers and commuters is prioritised. He said alternatives were provided on trains and buses, and that no other train system in the world offers travel rebates for such maintenance works.
